message.content: {"selected_action_id":"A2","rationale":"The pedestrian is crossing at x=20.2m with a lateral velocity of 1.4 m/s. At the ego vehicle's initial speed of 30 kph (~8.33 m/s), the vehicle will reach the conflict point in approximately 2.4 seconds. The pedestrian, starting at y=-4.0m, will be at y=-0.64m at that time, which is within the drivable lane (y >= -1.75m). Therefore, the ego vehicle must decelerate to yield to the pedestrian."}
